title: YouTube: Recommendations, Monetization, and Analytics
description: Add video recommendation algorithm, ad monetization, and creator analytics.

data.text: Add video recommendations based on watch history and tags, ad monetization with CPM tracking, and analytics dashboards for creators.

data.title: VideoRecommendation and AdService
Monetization basics
data.text: CPM (cost per mille) is revenue per 1000 ad impressions. Track impressions and clicks separately. Revenue = impressions * CPM / 1000.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Recommendations blend subscriptions and watch history
AdService tracks impressions and calculates revenue
Analytics aggregate views, watch time, and revenue
Creator dashboards are read models from analytics
data.takeaway: YouTube recommendations are a graph + ranking problem. Monetization is a simple CPM model. Analytics are the business layer on top of both.
